Other coroutines on that loop can stall; use a suitable async client or bounded offload.
The async keyword automatically makes every library call nonblocking.

How do you implement bounded concurrency
What protects an async ingestion worker from launching 100,000 requests at once?
A bounded worker pool/semaphore and a total cancellation/deadline policy.
Creating every task immediately with no resource budget.
Infinite retries without backoff.
Putting secrets into each exception message.
Bound in-flight work according to downstream capacity. Propagate cancellation, release resources and avoid collecting an unbounded number of pending tasks.

Keep data values separate from query syntax, while separately validating dynamic identifiers.
Concatenate user text after escaping only spaces.
